Changes how fast 3D sounds get quiet with distance, which [CreateListener](CreateListener) sets first. The change can glide over a time, so that walking from a cave into the open does not change every sound at once. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; Out of the cave, sounds carry further: half the rolloff over two seconds.
ListenerRolloff 0.5, 2000
```
@param value  `0` means sounds do not get quieter with distance, `1` is the normal rate and above that makes them fade faster. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap It works without a listener too, for the one at the origin that is there until [CreateListener](CreateListener) is called. A new value while one glides starts from where it has got to. [GetListenerRolloff](GetListenerRolloff) tells the value.
